description: This file implements Rime's text-to-speech services, including WebSocket and HTTP-based APIs, for streaming and batch audio synthesis. It defines classes for managing TTS sessions, handling WebSocket connections, and processing audio and timing data.

classes.name: RimeTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket-based TTS service using Rime's API, supporting streaming with word timing and context management.

classes.name: RimeHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based batch TTS service using Rime's API, suitable for non-streaming use cases.

classes.name: RimeNonJsonTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket TTS service for Rime models that communicate via plain text and raw audio bytes, without JSON.

methods.name: language_to_rime_language
methods.description: Converts a pipecat Language enum to Rime's three-letter language code.

methods.name: set_model
methods.description: Updates the TTS model used by the service.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech from text via streaming API, yielding audio frames.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the TTS service and establishes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the TTS service and closes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS operation and disconnects.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts message receiving task.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up tasks.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Connects to Rime WebSocket API with current settings.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns active WebSocket or raises exception if not connected.

methods.name: flush_audio
methods.description: Sends command to flush pending audio data.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, handling audio chunks and timestamps.
